description: Store a memory observation about a person, project, preference, or any entity. Automatically creates the entity if it doesn't exist. Every observation is cryptographically signed and linked to a receipt.

confidence.description: How confident you are in this observation (default: medium)

context.description: What conversation or task produced this observation

entity_name.description: Name of the entity (person, project, tool, etc.)

scope.description: Who can see this memory (default: agent)

ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live in seconds. After this duration, the observation expires and is excluded from recall but retained for audit.

name: memory_observe
